scope: M01: source-native Skin Identity 102, 103, 104, 105 only; historical China ConfigData snapshot, not global Skin completeness or current release status.

source.verification: Full UTF-8 source bytes retrieved independently and Git blob SHA-1 matched the GitHub file object; each selected ID occurs exactly once.
source.selection: Select records by explicit ID in [102, 103, 104, 105]; preserve only ID and Name verbatim. No numeric range, name matching, or ownership selection.
source.transformation: ID -> skinId without arithmetic or coercion. Name is source-reference text only and is not admitted as canonical localization.

semanticBasis.meaning: Source-native identifier of a Hero skin record. Legacy source interpretation explicitly joins HeroInfo.Skins_ID[] to this table's ID; the inspected builder indexes HeroSkinInfo by unique integer ID. M01 admits the four identities only.
semanticBasis.support: Direct source-native ID records establish existence; the prior source interpretation explains the identifier's Skin meaning. Generated parity is corroboration, not identity authority.

legacyComparison.validationScope: Stage1-2 compares 540 accepted regular-skin IDs, owner, order, identity, assets and acquisition to its upstream projection. Stage2-5 validates 540 forward/reverse relation edges over 267 Heroes. These are historical scopes, not Target completeness or M01 relation admission.
legacyComparison.transformationProvenance: build_hero_page_stage5_5_3.cjs selects explicit HeroInfo.Skins_ID entries, resolves each through the unique HeroSkinInfo.ID index and copies Name; generate-skin-stage1-1.py flattens upstream skins[].skinId into records[].skinId. This history is retained but not used as a future admission selector.
legacyComparison.rawSnapshotLimitation: The inspected historical raw snapshot is pinned separately. M01 does not assert that the Legacy generated artifacts were built from exactly this commit.

limitations: No game client build number or official publication date is established by the Git snapshot; its scope is the preserved source version.
Names support source inspection only; no Korean name or canonical Chinese localization is admitted.
Hero ownership and sourceOrder are comparison references only, deferred to M02. Neither is canonical nor an identity selection or sorting rule.
No assets, acquisition meaning, SP illustration, Soldier skin, release scope, generated consumer or frontend eligibility is admitted.
No authoritative contradiction was found within the inspected source and Legacy evidence; this is not a live-server or exhaustive external contradiction survey.
